content:
Alicia (Billing): FYI Voltix flagged a huge spike on their March invoice — they say embeddings doubled for a 2-hour window.
Priya (SRE): saw the alert from metering-bot, looking into ingestion logs now.
metering-bot: detected ~2x embed events for customer=voltix between 2026-03-12T02:10Z and 2026-03-12T04:05Z (pattern: duplicate ACKs)
Chris (Eng): we rolled the batched-ack change during the migration last week. possible window mis-alignment with the dedupe worker.
Priya (SRE): digging logs, here's a snippet showing duplicated ack receipts across two shards:
```
2026-03-12T02:12:05Z shard-4 ack:id=0x9f3e count=1
2026-03-12T02:12:05Z shard-7 ack:id=0x9f3e count=1
2026-03-12T02:12:06Z ingest worker processed id=0x9f3e -> emit embed-event
2026-03-12T02:12:07Z ingest worker duplicate processed id=0x9f3e -> emit embed-event
```
Priya (SRE): the problem looks like rare race between ack batching and shard handoff after the kernel update. two events emitted for same source id.
Alicia (Billing): Voltix impact: they got charged for ~7.8M extra embed units. Estimated overcharge $3.45k for that billing period (preliminary).
Mike (FinOps): rough estimate is fine. We need: (1) confirmation of exact dedupeable event count, (2) recommended remediation path (invoice credit vs negative invoice line vs future credit), (3) approvals to issue credit. Who signs off on <$5k credits?
Evan (Support): Voltix opened ticket #VOLT-783, unhappy but reasonable. They asked for an immediate pro-rata adjustment on the March bill.
Chris (Eng): I can run a targeted re-count using ingestion IDs and the ledger. PR to add a dedupe pass to the ingest-backfill tool. ETA: 6 hours to run and verify on staging, then 2h to run in prod with throttling.
Priya (SRE): corroborating logs -> will produce a CSV of duplicated ids and counts. I'll attach to the ticket when ready.
Alicia (Billing): For process: FinOps can approve one-off credits under $5k. Mike, can you authorize a $3.45k manual credit if dedupe-run confirms? Prefer to issue a negative invoice line rather than rerunning full billing backfill.
Mike (FinOps): I can approve up to $5k. Please include the CSV proof and a short summary. Approve in-thread with :thumbsup: once the CSV is attached.
Alicia (Billing): noted. Once we get CSV and final recount I'll draft the negative-line invoice and route to accounting for posting.
Chris (Eng): quick note: backfill option exists but will reprocess 48h of events and could cause small timing blips for rate-limit metering. Recommend negative line for customer experience.
Priya (SRE): uploading CSV now to ticket and pinging Voltix contact.
Priya (SRE): uploaded file: https://tickets.redwood/voltix/VOLT-783/attachments/dup_ids_20260312.csv
Alicia (Billing): got it. CSV shows 7,812,000 duplicated embed events. I'll compute final dollar amount and prepare credit.
Mike (FinOps): reviewed CSV, counts align with initial estimate. Approving $3,450 credit for Voltix. :thumbsup:
Alicia (Billing): thanks Mike. Will apply negative line item on March invoice and notify Voltix. Accounting: please post adj code "METER-DEDUP-0326".
Evan (Support): I'll update the customer: "We've identified a dedupe bug during a migration window and issued a $3,450 credit. We're also adding a permanent guard to prevent duplicate emits." sending now.
Chris (Eng): follow-up action items: (1) patch batching handshake to atomically commit ack ownership, (2) add end-to-end test covering shard handoff race, (3) add realtime dedupe alerting rule. I'll put up tickets and assign owners.
Priya (SRE): I'll create the monitoring alert (duplicate-emit-rate > 0.5% for 5m) and wire to paging for high-sev.
Alicia (Billing): closing loop — once accounting confirms the negative line posted, please drop a message here so I can close Voltix ticket.
accounting-bot: posted adjustment METER-DEDUP-0326 amt=-3450 to invoice 2026-03-01-Voltix. Reference: acct/adj/98765
Alicia (Billing): thanks everyone. Voltix updated and happy. We'll ship the fixes on next deploy, and I logged the credit approval for audits.
Mike (FinOps): good outcome. Please add a short postmortem blurb to the ticket summarizing root cause, impact, and remediation.
Evan (Support): will add PM notes and close on customer side. :white_check_mark:
notes: investigation, csv upload link, accounting adj code, approval by Mike (FinOps)
